title: Chapter 119 Request For Support
content:
Chapter 119 Request For Support

After a while, everyone dispersed.

Soon, only Yan Lingyun, Ao Qing, and the old man were left in the hall.

"Madam, when are we leaving?"

At this time, Ao Qing couldn't help asking.

Obviously, he couldn't wait any longer.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun smiled and said, "Ao Qing, this time, I was planning to let Mr. Zhou accompany Wang Zhen to the Tianlin Star Region."

Hearing this, Ao Qing was stunned.

At this time, Yan Lingyun continued, "The strength of the Tianlin Star Region is not simple."

"At least, it is much stronger than it looks on the surface. If there is only Wang Zhen, there will be accidents."

On the side, Mr. Zhou remained silent.

He was one of the few confidants around Yan Lingyun. He would not leave Yan Lingyun unless it was necessary.

But Yan Lingyun planned to let him take action when dealing with the Tianlin Star Region.

This is enough to show how much Yan Lingyun valued the Tianlin Star Region.

Hearing these words from Yan Lingyun, Ao Qing also understood.

"Don't worry, mistress. I'm here. Nothing unexpected will happen."

"Then it depends on your performance. Don't embarrass your master."

Yan Lingyun smiled.

Ao Qing then left.

"Your Majesty, how can Ao Qing reach such strength at such a young age?"

Old Zhou then expressed his doubts.

The dragon race's strength grows slower and slower as time goes by, but Ao Qing still looks so young. He not only achieved the position of a divine dragon, but also reached the super divine realm.

This speed is really a bit abnormal.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun smiled and said slowly: "Because he has a good master."

Hearing this, Old Zhou was shocked.

Ao Qing's master.

Isn't that your Majesty's man?

When Yan Lingyun dragged Lu Xue back to the Divine Dynasty and announced that it was her daughter, the entire Divine Dynasty was completely shocked.

Your Majesty actually has a daughter!

And she is already so big.

But who did your Majesty have the daughter with? This is a big question.

Anyway, no one dared to ask in the entire Divine Dynasty.

Their Majesty did not say it either, so until now, they were just guessing about the identity of the Majesty's man.

But now, Old Zhou is sure that the Majesty's man is definitely not an ordinary person!

You must know that there are people beyond people, and there are heavens beyond heavens.

Even their Divine Dynasty dare not say that there are no rivals.

Old Zhou was not surprised that there were people in the outside world who were more powerful than their Majesty.

Looking up slightly and seeing Yan Lingyun's happy smile, Old Zhou couldn't help but tremble all over, and then hurriedly retreated quietly.

"General Wang."

On the way back, Wang Zhen suddenly heard a shout behind him and stopped immediately.

"Oh? Old Zhou is looking for me, but is there something?"

Seeing Old Zhou, Wang Zhen said respectfully.

Obviously, Old Zhou has a very high status in the Divine Dynasty.

Looking at Wang Zhen, Old Zhou simply asked, "What do you think of the Tianlin Star Region?"

Hearing this, Wang Zhen smiled and said, "Don't worry, Old Zhou, I will definitely succeed with my help."

Looking at Wang Zhen's confident smile, Old Zhou shook his head slightly.

"The Tianlin Star Region is home to a strategically important area of great value. Once the Tianlin Star Region is taken, the army of our Divine Dynasty will march straight in without any obstacles."

"Do you think those forces that are afraid of our Divine Dynasty will allow our Divine Dynasty to attack the Tianlin Star Region at will?"

Hearing this, Wang Zhen's smile gradually disappeared.

After a moment, Wang Zhen slowly said, "Old Zhou, what you said makes sense, but..."

Wang Zhen leaned his head towards Old Zhou's ear and whispered a few words.

Then Old Zhou looked at Wang Zhen unexpectedly.

"Old Zhou, how is it?"

Wang Zhen looked at Old Zhou with some pride.

After a moment of silence, Mr. Zhou patted Wang Zhen on the shoulder and said softly: "Just do your best, and be respectful to Ao Qing. The beasts around the princess are not simple beings."

Hearing this, Wang Zhen was stunned.

When he reacted, Mr. Zhou had already walked away.

Wang Zhen frowned slightly.

Tianlin Star Region.

Inside Tianlin Palace.

This is the strongest force in Tianlin Star Region.

At this moment, several powerful figures in the palace were frowning.

The atmosphere was extremely depressing.

"What should we do?"

At this time, a strong man spoke.

But everyone was silent.

The Divine Dynasty is coming, what can they do?

Surrender?

But if they surrender, the entire Tianlin Star Region will be handed over to others.

But if they resist, it is so unrealistic.

The strength of the Divine Dynasty is really too terrifying.

It is not at the same level at all.

The only thing to be thankful for is that the Divine Dynasty only sent an army, plus some strong men.

They were not killed instantly.

"Hey, ask for support."

After a long silence, a middle-aged man in the lead said slowly.

The Lord of Tianlin Temple.

In fact, he was still the deputy Lord in the morning.

Knowing that the Divine Dynasty was about to attack, the old Lord directly appointed him as the new Lord, and then disappeared without a trace.

Such a heavy burden as soon as he took office.

He was a little overwhelmed.

"Old Lord, can I surrender directly?"

"Surrender? Then are you worthy of the ancestors of Tianlin Temple?"

"Then what should I do, that's the Divine Dynasty!"

"I don't care what you do. Anyway, if Tianlin Palace is gone, it's your responsibility, not mine."

Thinking of this, Luo Ming sighed again.

What's going on?

At this time, an elder asked, "Palace Master, who should we find to help us?"

Hearing this, Luo Ming said in a deep voice, "I don't believe that they will watch my Tianlin Star Region being taken down by the Divine Dynasty."

"Tell all the forces that are hostile to the Divine Dynasty that if they don't come, my Tianlin Star Region will surrender."

Then, let's see who will be anxious.

Hearing this, everyone in the palace suddenly brightened up.

"I obey the order!"

"By the way, Palace Master, a very powerful force suddenly appeared in the northern star region, showing its edge, and now it is heading towards this side."

"What? What force is that?"

"It seems to be called Huangcheng."

......

On the other side.

At this time, Yunqi was leading the army, and he was unstoppable all the way. Wherever he went, it was the territory of Huangcheng.

"Hahaha, so happy!"

On the cruel battlefield, Yunqi swung his long sword and screamed with excitement.

At this moment, his strength has reached the God Emperor Realm.

Facing these star domain forces that are not even at the God Emperor Realm, Yunqi won continuously without any surprise.

But he was not careless, these were just inferior star domains.

The real strength is behind.

This time, the five million Lu family troops led by him finally began to show their edge after years of hard training.

In the deserted city.

"Lord City Lord, Brother Yunqi has taken seven star domains."

An Xing said respectfully.

After hearing An Xing's report, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Did other forces try to stop it?"

An Xing shook his head, "Lord City Lord, those forces that have the strength to stop Brother Yunqi chose to stay put and did not make any moves."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

It seems that they have not yet realized the seriousness of the matter.

Then it is not his fault.

"By the way, continue to send spies to the south and report all the collected information back to the deserted city."

"Yes, Lord City Lord!"
